summary: Allow legacy base locks during standard upgrade verification

delivery.outcome: Allow repositories upgrading from older standards (such as 0.14) with legacy partial-subset locks to verify and adopt modern standard versions without false-positive lock mismatch errors.
nonGoals: No bypass of target-owned takeover checks or head lock validation.

architecture.decision: Support set(base_hashes) <= set(base_strategies) in load_standard_adoption_evidence and check membership in base_hashes within verify_managed_base.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore strict set equality on base locks.

commands: uv run --with pytest --with jsonschema pytest -q tests/
validation.evidence: All existing pytest and validator tests pass.
